hazelnut.Type: A small, edible seed commonly found in forests and used in culinary and nut-based products.
hazelnut.Color: Brown to dark brown with a slight golden hue on the outer shell, often with a pale yellow or cream-colored interior when roasted.
hazelnut.Material: Natural seed with a hard outer shell and a soft, oily kernel inside.
hazelnut.Composition: Primarily composed of fats, proteins, and carbohydrates, with a high content of monounsaturated fats and fiber.
hazelnut.Quantity: Varies depending on the source, typically found in clusters or in small quantities in natural environments or packaged in bulk for consumption.
hazelnut.Relative Location: Commonly found in forested areas, under trees such as hazel, or in cultivated gardens and orchards.
hazelnut.Orientation: Usually found with the pointed end facing upward or slightly tilted, depending on the environment.
hazelnut.Connection or Attachments: No attachments; typically found as individual seeds or in small groups, not connected to other objects.
